Schuyler Social Branch

9970

Misc.No. 323/40.       "B"
                        B'Well
                        April 28th.,    40.

1.

MURDER OF W.B. CARINE (BRITISH).

At 9.22 a.m. 28/4/40 a telephone message was
received from an unknown foreign lady reporting a
shooting affray in Crescent Avenue, off Yu Yuen Road.

A party of police under D.I. Tabrum attended
and found on arrival that a British Subject by name
William B. Carine had been shot by two unknown male
Chinese.

The shot man, who appeared to be dead at the
time of the arrival of the police party, was conveyed
to the Country Hospital by S.M.C. emergency ambulance
but was examined and pronounced dead on arrival by
the Resident Medical Superintendent Dr. J.E. Bowen.

The location of the scene of the offence is on
a small bridge crossing the Ts Yu Pang ( 自由浜 )
Creek on Crescent Avenue, which is a private road
belonging to the Imperial Chemical Industries (China)
Ltd. located on the south side of Yu Yuen Road. The
bridge in question is about two hundred yards south
of Yu Yuen Road and immediately north of it is a foot-
path running east to west along the banks of the creek.

On the south side of the bridge and about 100
yards south is a further footpath which runs along the
creek bank in front of the I.C.I. quarters compound.
pages.zh:
施凯勒社会科 (Schuyler Social Branch)

9970
1 5 40

杂项编号 323/40.       "B"
                        百老汇路 (B'Well)
                        1940年4月28日。

1.

W.B. 卡林（英国人）被杀案。

1940年4月28日上午9时22分，接到一名身份不明的外籍女士打来的电话，报告在愚园路旁的新月路（Crescent Avenue）发生枪击事件。

由探目塔布鲁姆（Tabrum）率领的一队警员赶赴现场，抵达后发现一名名为威廉·B·卡林（William B. Carine）的英籍人士遭两名身份不明的中国男子枪击。

该中枪男子在警队抵达时看似已死亡，随后由工部局急救救护车送往乡村医院（Country Hospital），经驻院医务总监 J.E. 鲍恩（J.E. Bowen）医生检查，宣布其于抵达时死亡。

案发地点位于新月路上跨越自由浜（Ts Yu Pang）小河的一座小桥上，新月路是位于愚园路南侧、属于卜内门化学工业（中国）有限公司（Imperial Chemical Industries (China) Ltd.）的一条私人道路。该桥位于愚园路以南约两百码处，紧邻其北侧有一条沿河岸东西向延伸的人行道。

桥的南侧再往南约100码处，还有另一条人行道，沿着卜内门公司宿舍区前的河岸延伸。

pages.en:
Miss. No. 323/40.

1/2.

The deceased was found lying on the east side
of the bridge, about 3 yards from the north bank.
He was on his back with his head pointing to the
south.

A close search of the vicinity was conducted
but no empty cartridge cases could be found.

The deceased occupied a very small room in the
servants quarters of the compound and a search of
this by detectives and Mr. E.A. Cooke of the I.S.I.
Ltd., discovered various documents establishing the
identity of the deceased as:-

William Blythe Carine, British
Born 24 June 1887 at Port Erin,
I.O.M. Married.

He was at one time employed in the Chinese
Maritime Customs but for some time prior to August
1937 was without steady employment.

At the latter end 1937 he secured a position as
a private watchman in Crescent Avenue with the I.C.I.
and he resided in the compound but his wife Lo Ping
Carine and his daughter Julia Elizabeth Carine reside
together at 52 Hwakes AVENUE Road.

They were located and brought to the station
where they were closely questioned but could offer
pages.zh:
杂项编号 323/40.

1/2.

死者被发现躺在桥的东侧，距北岸约3码处。他仰面躺着，头部朝南。

对附近进行了仔细搜查，但未发现空弹壳。

死者居住在宿舍区仆人宿舍的一个非常小的房间里，侦探和卜内门有限公司的 E.A. 库克（E.A. Cooke）先生对该房间进行了搜查，发现了各种文件，证实死者身份为：

威廉·布莱思·卡林（William Blythe Carine），英国人
1887年6月24日出生于马恩岛（I.O.M.）波特埃林（Port Erin）。已婚。

他曾受雇于中国海关，但在1937年8月之前的一段时间内没有固定工作。

1937年底，他在新月路的卜内门公司获得了一份私人看守的职位，并居住在宿舍区内，但其妻子罗平·卡林（Lo Ping Carine）和女儿朱莉娅·伊丽莎白·卡林（Julia Elizabeth Carine）一同居住在华克路（Hwakes AVENUE Road）52号。

她们被找到并带到警局，受到严密讯问，但未能提供

pages.en:
Miss.No. 323/40.

1/3.

no information that might throw any light on the
reason for the murder. Miss Carine did state,
however, that the deceased had several times had
trouble with members of the S.C.G.P.B. when, in
accordance with instructions from his employers,
he had endeavoured to stop them using the Crescent
Avenue as a short cut from Yu Yuan Road to the
country either side.

Enquiries conducted by detectives in the
vicinity succeeded in locating three witnesses, of
whom the more important is one Fan Yung Fah (范永華)
aged 10, residing in a wooden hut in West Ts Yu Pang
(西自由浜, a few yards east of the bridge in
Crescent Avenue.

He states that at about 9.20a.m. 28/4/40, whilst
he was playing outside his home, he saw the deceased
stop two male Chinese, one dressed in a grey long
gown and the other in foreign clothing, who were
proceeding South to North over the Crescent Avenue
Bridge. Some words passed and the man wearing the
long gown pulled out a pistol from beneath his gown
and fired one shot at deceased. The man wearing
foreign clothes then also produced a pistol and fired
two shots at deceased. They then decamped north
pages.zh:
杂项编号 323/40.

1/3.

任何可能揭示谋杀原因的信息。不过，卡林小姐确实表示，死者曾多次与上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.C.G.P.B.）成员发生冲突，当时他按照雇主的指示，试图阻止这些人将新月路作为从愚园路通往两侧乡间的捷径。

侦探在附近进行的调查成功找到了三名证人，其中较为重要的一位是范永華（Fan Yung Fah），10岁，居住在新月路桥以东几码处的西自由浜（West Ts Yu Pang）的一间木棚屋内。

他陈述称，1940年4月28日上午9时20分左右，当他在家门外玩耍时，看见死者拦住了两名中国男子，其中一人身穿灰色长衫，另一人身穿西式服装，他们正由南向北经过新月路桥。双方交谈了几句，穿长衫的男子从长衫下掏出手枪，向死者开了一枪。穿西式服装的男子也掏出手枪，向死者开了两枪。随后他们向北逃窜，

pages.en:
Misc.No. 323/40.

1/4.

along Crescent Avenue turning east into the West
Ts Yu Pang, firing two more shots as they ran.
A very similar account of the affair is given
by one Zee Too Kung (錢土柄) a gardener employed
in the I.C.I. compound, who states that the pistols
used appeared to be Mausers.
The remaining witness Lee Vung Tsung (李文當)
also a gardener, did not witness the actual shooting
but saw the assassins decamping.
To time of making this report no other information
of value is to hand.
（批：Inspector Yamaguchi informed. D.M.O. 94 Jebsen co. Ay）
All officers concerned were informed and D.O. and
D.D.O. "B" and C. of P. attended the station.
Special Branch informed British Military informed.
Inspector Tang Dau Tswen (王道存) of S.C.G.P.B.
attended the station and was given particulars of the
case.
Mr. C.H. Haines, British Court Coroner, was
informed and arranged to attend and have the body,
which is at present in the mortuary of the Country
Hospital, identified at 9.30a.m. 29/4/40.
A point which may be of interest is that deceased,
according to his wife and daughter, had a very poor
knowledge of Chinese.

Sen.D. 29/4/40. May
L. A. Young
D. S. I.
pages.zh:
杂项编号 323/40.

1/4.

沿着新月路向北，转入西自由浜，逃跑过程中又开了两枪。
卜内门宿舍区雇佣的一名园丁钱土柄（Zee Too Kung）对此事的描述非常相似，他指出使用的手枪似乎是毛瑟枪。
另一名证人李文當（Lee Vung Tsung）也是一名园丁，他没有目睹实际开枪过程，但看到了刺客逃窜。
截至本报告撰写时，尚未掌握其他有价值的情报。
（批注：已通知山口巡官。副医务总监 94 杰布森公司 Ay）
所有相关警官均已获知此事，"B" 区和 "C" 区的巡官及副巡官以及警察处长亲临警局。
已通知特别支部。已通知英国军方。
上海公共租界工部局警务处的王道存（Tang Dau Tswen）巡官来到警局，获悉了案件详情。
已通知英国法庭验尸官 C.H. 海恩斯（C.H. Haines）先生，他安排于1940年4月29日上午9时30分前往目前停放在乡村医院太平间的尸体处进行辨认。
一个可能令人感兴趣的点是，据其妻女称，死者的中文知识非常贫乏。

高级侦探督察 1940年4月29日. May
L. A. Young
副侦探督察

pages.en:
an Yung Fah (垣永茂)

Tientsin                                      D.S.I. Chu Chi Huang
B'well Stn.              28/4/40              D.S.I. Chu Chi Huang.

My name is an Yung Fah, age 10, native of Tientsin,
residing in a wooden hut in est Ts Yu Fang, a few yards
East of the bridge of the Crescent Avenue.
At about 9.20a.m. 28/4/40, whilst I was playing outside
my home, I saw the foreign watchman of the Crescent Avenue
stop two male Chinese, one of them dressed in a grey colour
long gown and the other in foreign clothing, who were proceed-
ing along Crescent Avenue from South to North on the bridge.
After being stopped, the man wearing long gown pulled out a
pistol from under his gown and fired one shot at the foreign
watchman. The other wearing foreign clothing also produced
a pistol and fired two shots at the foreigner. After which
they decamped and they fired two more shots as they were
decamping. They ran North along Crescent Avenue and turned
into West Ts Yu Fang, passing my home and disappeared into
S.C.G.F.B. territory.

                                            (Sgd.) an Yung Fah.
pages.zh:
an Yung Fah (垣永茂) [注：此处原文拼音与汉字对应可能有误，前文为范永華]

天津                                      副侦探督察 朱志煌 (Chu Chi Huang)
百老汇路警局              1940年4月28日              副侦探督察 朱志煌。

我叫 an Yung Fah，10岁，天津人，居住在东自由浜（est Ts Yu Fang [原文如此，应为West或East之误，结合上下文及前文应为西自由浜或东自由浜，此处照录]）的一间木棚屋内，位于新月路桥以东几码处。
1940年4月28日上午9时20分左右，当我在家门外玩耍时，我看见新月路的外国看守拦住了两名中国男子，其中一人身穿灰色长衫，另一人身穿西式服装，他们正沿着新月路桥由南向北行进。
被拦住后，穿长衫的男子从长衫下掏出手枪，向外国看守开了一枪。另一名穿西式服装的男子也掏出手枪，向该外国人开了两枪。之后他们逃窜，并在逃窜过程中又开了两枪。他们沿着新月路向北跑，转入西自由浜（West Ts Yu Fang），经过我家，消失在 S.C.G.F.B. [原文如此，应为S.C.G.P.B.] 地界内。

                                            (签名) an Yung Fah.

pages.en:
Zee Toc Kung (錢土根)
Shanghai                                      Clerk Sih Chien Sih
B'Well Stn.            28/4/40       translated
                                       xxxxxx      Clerk Sih Chien Shih.

My name is Zee Too Kung, age 26 years, native of Shanghai,
married, gardener employed at the Imperial Chemical Industries,
Crescent Avenue, residing at No.6 Heu Kya Zah off Avenue Haig.
    At about 9.20a.m. 28/4/40, while I was making a bamboo-
shed in the garden of House No.5 Crescent Avenue, together
with another gardener named Lee Vung Tsung, I saw the approach
of a foreign watchman from South to North.    I said to him in
English "To day is very hot" and he replied "Yes", after that
he walked North.    After not more than one minute, I heard one
shot fired and the foreign watchman shouting "O-o-o-o" which
was followed by several more shots.    I turned my head and saw
two Chinese males, one wearing black short clothing, armed
with a long barrelled pistol, fire one more shot at the foreign
watchman who was lying facing the ground while the other, also
armed with a long barrelled pistol, was picking up something
from the ground, after which they run into the East Ts Yu Pang
Village.    The scene of the shooting was about 20 yards away
from the place where I was standing.    The arms carried by the
2 men appear to be mausers.

                        (Signed & Crossmarked) Zee Too Kung.
pages.zh:
钱土根 (Zee Toc Kung) [注：前文译为钱土柄，此处拼音略有不同，汉字相同]
上海                                      职员 Sih Chien Sih
百老汇路警局            1940年4月28日       翻译
                                       xxxxxx      职员 Sih Chien Shih.

我叫 Zee Too Kung，26岁，上海人，已婚，受雇于新月路卜内门公司的园丁，居住在海格路（Avenue Haig）旁的侯家宅（Heu Kya Zah）6号。
    1940年4月28日上午9时20分左右，当我和另一名名叫李文當（Lee Vung Tsung）的园丁一起在新月路5号的花园里搭建竹棚时，我看见一名外国看守由南向北走来。我用英语对他说“今天很热”，他回答“是的”，之后他向北走去。不到一分钟后，我听到一声枪响，那名外国看守大喊“O-o-o-o”，紧接着又是几声枪响。我转过头，看见两名中国男子，其中一人身穿黑色短装，手持一支长枪管手枪，向面朝地面躺着的 foreign watchman [外国看守] 又开了一枪，而另一人也手持一支长枪管手枪，正在从地上捡起什么东西，随后他们跑进了东自由浜村（East Ts Yu Pang Village）。枪击现场距离我站立的地方约20码。这两人携带的武器似乎是毛瑟枪。

                        (签名并画十字) Zee Too Kung.

pages.en:
Lee Vung Tsung ( 李 文 崇 )
Shanghai                                      Clerk Sih Chien Shih
                                               translated
B'Well Stn.           28/4/40                  xxxxxx      Clerk Sih Chien Shih.

My name is Lee Vung Tsung, age 28 years, native of
Shanghai, married, gardener, residing at Kyung Kya Hoong
off Kiaochow Road.
    I am a temporary gardener employed at the Imperial
Chemical Industries, Crescent Avenue.    At about 9.20 a.m.
28/4/40, when I was making a bamboo-shed in the garden of
House No.5 Crescent Avenue together with another gardener
named Zee Too Kung, I saw the foreign watchman coming out.
(from the compound).    About one minute later, I heard
several shots fired outside and the foreign watchman shouting.
When I turned my head, I saw two male Chinese running away
into East Ts Yu Pang Village.    The scene of the shooting was
about 20 yards away from the spot where I was standing.

                                    (Crossmarked) Lee Vung Tsung.
pages.zh:
李 文 崇 (Lee Vung Tsung)
上海                                      职员 Sih Chien Shih
                                               翻译
百老汇路警局           1940年4月28日                  xxxxxx      职员 Sih Chien Shih.

我叫 Lee Vung Tsung，28岁，上海人，已婚，园丁，居住在高州路（Kiaochow Road）旁的 Kyung Kya Hoong [音译：龚家洪/龚家巷?]。
    我是受雇于新月路卜内门公司的临时园丁。1940年4月28日上午9时20分左右，当我和另一名名叫 Zee Too Kung 的园丁一起在新月路5号的花园里搭建竹棚时，我看见那名外国看守走出来（从宿舍区）。大约一分钟后，我听到外面几声枪响和那名外国看守的叫喊声。当我转过头时，我看见两名中国男子跑进了东自由浜村（East Ts Yu Pang Village）。枪击现场距离我站立的地方约20码。

                                    (画十字) Lee Vung Tsung.

pages.en:
APR 29 1940

British Subject Murdered
By Two Chinese Gunmen

Mr. William B. Carine,
Caretaker In West Area,
Killed By Thugs' Bullets

Elderly Employee Of I.C.I. Was Approaching Two
Chinese Trespassers When Both Produced
Pistols And Fired At Point-Blank Range

CHINESE ESCAPE AFTER COLD-BLOODED
MURDER; INQUEST OPENS TO-DAY

Alone, unarmed and while doing his duty, Mr. William B.
Carine, a 53-year-old British subject, was shot dead in cold
blood by two armed Chinese gunmen in Crescent Avenue, off
Yu Yuen Road, at 9.20 o'clock yesterday morning, just after
he had begun to interrogate them as to the reason for their
presence on that private road belonging to the Imperial
Chemical Industries, Ltd.

Seeing the two suspicious-looking Chinese trespassing in
the lane, Mr. Carine, who was caretaker of the I.C.I. residential
property on Crescent Avenue, questioned them, and, according
of Chinese eye-witnesses, had only said a few words when the
trespassers drew their pistols and fired three shots at him. He
fell mortally wounded and died before he reached the Country
Hospital.

Mr. Carine was a native of Port
Erin, Isle of Man, and had been a
sailor in the merchant marine and
an employee of the China Maritime
Customs before he was engaged by
the I.C.I. about two and a half
years ago as caretaker of their pro-
perty at Crescent Avenue, just
opposite the Hollywood Gardens on
Yu Yuen Road.

Mr. Carine was an elderly man
and entirely without means of self-
defence, when the gunmen com-
mitted this dastardly and cowardly
murder. He leaves behind a wife
and a daughter here in Shanghai.

Police Investigating

The Shanghai Municipal Police
are making all inquiries to try to
bring these two murderers to
justice, but they are handicapped
by the fact that Crescent Avenue
and the surrounding area is in
Chinese territory. A party of police
was sent to the scene directly in-
formation of the shooting reached
the station, but Mr. Carine was
found already beyond human aid.
An ambulance was sent for and he
was rushed to the Country Hos-
pital, but was pronounced dead on
arrival.

An inquest on the body will open
this morning at the Country Hos-
pital, when the body will be iden-
tified before H. M. Coroner, Mr.
C. H. Haines.

The gunmen escaped into the
surrounding "badlands" area after
committing the crime, and late last
night no arrests had been made,
nor suspects detained. There ap-
pears to be no motive for the
crime; just an over-readiness on
the part of the gunmen to draw
and use their pistols. They were
probably afraid the caretaker
would detain them for trespassing
and, therefore, cut short the argu-
ment by drilling his body with
lead. The Chinese were armed
with Mauser pistols and one fired
two shots and the other one. All
three bullets lodged in the deceas-
ed's body.

Scene Of Murder

Crescent Avenue is a private
road belonging to the Imperial
Chemical Industries, Ltd., and it
leads from Yu Yuen Road to a
large compound, where there are
several large houses, owned by the
I.C.I. and dwelt in by senior mem-
bers of the I.C.I. staff here. At
the entrance to the compound is a
little room, where the caretaker
sits and keeps the property under
observation.

On the lane, leading from Yu
Yuen Road to the compound, is
a bridge about 200 yards from Yu
Yuen Road, and it was on this
bridge that the murder took place.
The Chinese were crossing the
lane by a public footpath over a
bridge spanning a small creek, call-
ed Ts Yue Pang. Mr. Carine made
it his practice to question Chinese
now and then when they crossed
the private drive. He was doing
this yesterday, when he met his
untimely and violent death.

Although Mr. Carine spent a
large part of his time in the care-
taker's hut, his home was at 53,
Hwakee Avenue, where his wife
and daughter live. Mr. Carine, came
to Shanghai many years ago as a
merchant sailor. He left his ship
and settled in Shanghai. He had a
job in the Customs for a while
and was unemployed for a time.
Finally he obtained the I.C.I. care-
taker's job at Crescent Avenue
about two and a half years ago,
and had been doing his duty quiet-
ly and regularly ever since. He
was quiet by nature and although
the police used to call him "Jock,"
he never spoke much to any of
them.

When he first came to Shanghai,
Mr. Carine married. He has one
daughter, Miss Julia Carine, who is
employed at the Nederlandsch In-
dische Bank.

Cartridges Found

The three cartridge cases of the
bullets fired by the Chinese were
picked up by the Police on the
bridge and are being kept for bal-
listic examination. The Police offi-
cer in charge of the case is Detec-
tive Sub-Inspector S. A. Young, of
Bubbling Well Police Station.

When he met his death, Mr. Carine
was dressed in plain civilian clothes
and not in caretaker's uniform. The
Chinese, according to eye-witnesses
from houses nearby, were dressed
one in foreign and one in Chinese
clothes.

Although Chinese reports state
that Mr. Carine was a bodyguard of
Mr. G. A. Haley, one of the newly-
elected British Councillors of the
S.M.C., this is incorrect. Carine
was caretaker of the I.C.I. estate,
and Mr. G. A. Haley was only one
of the directors of the I.C.I. who
happened to live on this estate.

Casual police opinions of the
murder were that it was criminal
and entirely purposeless. It was
un-premeditated and a sad waste
of a life, and the pity is that
gangsters should have such easy
access to pistols and ammunition
that they are ready to shoot anyone
who asks them a question.

No date had been set yesterday
for the funeral.
pages.zh:
1940年4月29日

英国侨民遭两名中国枪手杀害

西区看管员威廉·B·卡林先生
死于暴徒子弹之下

帝国化学工业公司（I.C.I.）的一名老员工在走近两名中国非法闯入者时，两人掏出手枪，近距离向他射击

冷血谋杀后中国人逃脱；今日开启死因研讯

昨日（星期一）上午9时20分，53岁的英国侨民威廉·B·卡林（William B. Carine）先生在独自 unarmed 执勤时，在愚园路旁的月牙路（Crescent Avenue）被两名武装中国枪手冷血枪杀。当时他刚刚开始盘问这两人为何出现在属于帝国化学工业有限公司（Imperial Chemical Industries, Ltd.）的这条私人道路上。

卡林先生是月牙路帝国化学工业公司住宅物业的看管员，他看到两名形迹可疑的中国人在弄堂里非法闯入，便上前盘问。据中国目击者称，他只说了几句话，闯入者就拔出手枪，向他开了三枪。他受致命伤倒地，在送往宏恩医院（Country Hospital）途中死亡。

卡林先生是马恩岛（Isle of Man）波特埃林（Port Erin）人，在被帝国化学工业公司雇用为月牙路物业看管员之前，曾是一名商船海员和中国海关职员。该职位是他约两年半前获得的，其工作地点位于愚园路好莱坞花园（Hollywood Gardens）正对面。

当枪手犯下这起卑鄙懦弱的谋杀案时，卡林先生是一位老人，完全没有任何自卫手段。他在上海留有妻子和女儿。

警方正在调查

上海公共租界工部局警务处正在进行各项调查，试图将这两名凶手绳之以法，但受到不利条件制约，因为月牙路及周边地区位于华界。接到枪击报告后，一队警察立即被派往现场，但发现卡林先生已回天乏术。随后叫来救护车，将他紧急送往宏恩医院，但抵达时被宣布死亡。

今天上午将在宏恩医院对尸体进行死因研讯，届时将由英王陛下验尸官 C. H. Haines 先生主持辨认尸体。

枪手作案后逃入周边的“歹土”（badlands）区域，截至昨晚深夜，尚未逮捕任何人，也未拘留任何嫌疑人。此案似乎没有动机；只是枪手过于急于拔枪和使用手枪。他们可能担心看管员会因非法闯入而扣留他们，因此用铅弹射穿他的身体以终止争执。这两名中国人携带的是毛瑟手枪，其中一人开了两枪，另一人开了一枪。三颗子弹均留在死者体内。

谋杀现场

月牙路是一条属于帝国化学工业有限公司的私人道路，从愚园路通向一个大院，院内有几栋大房子，归帝国化学工业公司所有，由该公司驻沪高级职员居住。大院入口处有一间小房间，看管员坐在那里监视物业。

在从愚园路通向大院的弄堂里，距离愚园路约200码处有一座桥，谋杀就发生在这座桥上。当时这两名中国人正通过一座横跨名为“Ts Yue Pang”（音译）的小溪的桥梁上的人行便道穿过弄堂。卡林先生习惯于偶尔盘问穿过这条私人车道的中国人。昨天他正是在这样做时，遭遇了不幸且暴力的死亡。

虽然卡林先生大部分时间待在看管员的棚屋里，但他的家住在华克路（Hwakee Avenue）53号，他的妻子和女儿住在那里。卡林先生多年前作为商船海员来到上海。他离开船只后定居上海。他曾在海关工作过一段时间，之后失业了一段时间。最终，他在约两年半前获得了月牙路帝国化学工业公司看管员的职位，此后一直安静而规律地履行职责。他天性安静，虽然警察常叫他“Jock”（苏格兰人昵称），但他很少与他们中的任何人交谈。

卡林先生初到上海时结了婚。他有一个女儿，朱莉娅·卡林小姐（Miss Julia Carine），目前在荷兰印度银行（Nederlandsch Indische Bank）任职。

发现弹壳

警方在桥上捡到了中国人发射的三颗子弹的弹壳，正保留用于弹道检验。负责此案的警官是静安寺捕房的侦探副督察 S. A. Young。

卡林先生遇害时身穿普通便服，而非看管员制服。据附近房屋的目击者称，这两名中国人中，一人穿西装，一人穿中式服装。

尽管有中文报道称卡林先生是上海公共租界工部局新当选的英籍董事 G. A. Haley 先生的保镖，但这并不正确。卡林是帝国化学工业公司地产的看管员，而 G. A. Haley 先生只是碰巧住在该地产上的帝国化学工业公司董事之一。

警方对这起谋杀案的随意看法是，这是一起刑事犯罪，且完全毫无目的。这是未经预谋的，是对生命的悲惨浪费，令人遗憾的是，匪徒可以如此轻易地获得手枪和弹药，以至于他们准备向任何询问他们问题的人开枪。

昨天尚未确定葬礼日期。

NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS
APR 29 1948

Briton Shot Dead
At I.C.I. Garden

Mr. W. B. Carine Attacked
By Chinese Gunmen in
Crescent Avenue

Mr. William Blyth Carine, 53-year-old Briton, was shot and fatally wounded by two unidentified Chinese gunmen in Crescent Avenue, off Yu Yuen Road, at 9.20 o'clock yesterday morning. The murderers escaped by running into the "badlands."

Mr. Carine, who was employed as caretaker of the Imperial Chemical Industries property in Crescent Avenue, was attacked when he challenged the two Chinese as they were about to cross the small bridge there, on their way to Yu Yuen Road. Crescent Avenue is a private road, and the men were trespassing.

Resenting the challenge, one of the Chinese, dressed in a grey long-gown, pulled a military Mauser pistol from under his clothing and fired one shot at Mr. Carine at close range. The other intruder, who was wearing a foreign-style suit, likewise drew a large Mauser, and fired twice. Their victim, who was unarmed, dropped to the ground mortally wounded. He died shortly afterward in the Country Hospital, where he was taken by ambulance.

The assassins turned quickly and ran into extra-Settlement territory where they had no difficulty in escaping. When, later, police were called from the Bubbling Well Station no trace was left of the pair.

Mr. Carine, a native of the Isle of Man and a veteran of the Great War in which he served in the Royal Navy, had only recently been engaged to look after the I.C.I. property in Crescent Avenue. He was formerly employed by the Chinese Maritime Customs, at Kowloon, Kwangtung, and elsewhere. He leaves a widow and a daughter, in Shanghai.
pages.zh:
《字林西报》
1948年4月29日

英国人在帝国化学工业公司花园被枪杀

W. B. 卡林先生在月牙路遭中国枪手袭击

53岁的英国人威廉·布莱思·卡林（William Blyth Carine）先生于昨日上午9时20分在愚园路旁的月牙路被两名身份不明的中国枪手枪击，受致命伤。凶手跑进“歹土”区域逃脱。

卡林先生受雇为帝国化学工业公司在月牙路物业的看管员，当他在那里的一个小桥边拦截两名正准备穿过桥梁前往愚园路的中国人的时候遭到袭击。月牙路是一条私人道路，这些人属于非法闯入。

其中一名身穿灰色长衫的中国人对盘问表示不满，从衣服下掏出一把军用毛瑟手枪，近距离向卡林先生开了一枪。另一名入侵者身穿西式西装，也拔出一把大号毛瑟手枪，开了两枪。手无寸铁的受害者受致命伤倒在地上。他被救护车送往宏恩医院后不久死亡。

刺客迅速转身跑进越界筑路区域（extra-Settlement territory），毫不费力地逃脱了。后来，当静安寺捕房派出警察时，那两人的踪迹已消失。

卡林先生是马恩岛人，也是第一次世界大战的老兵，曾在皇家海军服役，最近才受雇照看月牙路的帝国化学工业公司物业。他此前曾在广东九龙等地的中国海关任职。他在上海留有遗孀和女儿。

pages.en:
CHINA PRESS.
APR 29 1946

**Briton Murdered**
**In Badlands**

**Caretaker For I.C.I.,**
**W. B. Carine, Slain**
**By Two Terrorists**

Terrorism flared anew in Shanghai yesterday, when Mr. William Blythe Carine, British caretaker of the Imperial Chemical. Industrial, Ltd., compound, was shot and killed in cold-blood in the Badlands.

The 53-year-old Briton was slain by two Chinese who drew their pistols and brutally pumped bullets into him after he had ordered them from the compound, situated on Crescent Avenue off Yu Yuen Road. Rushed to the hospital in an ambulance, he died before arriving there.

At about 9:20 a.m., the two assassins approached the I.C.I. premises, which are near to the Hollywood gambling den. Mr. Carine challenged them, according to police reports, and told them that it was private property, and that if they crossed, they were trespassing. Finally, he ordered them to leave.

**Deliberately Fires**

At this time, the terrorist in the van calmly and deliberately reached for his pistol, and fired at point-blank range. Then the second man also drew his gun, and leveling it at the caretaker, pulled the trigger several times. The shots sped home; Mr. Carine slumped to the ground, mortally wounded.

The killers then escaped without difficulty into the Badlands. No assistance being offered by several bystanders who were attracted by the sound of the shooting.

When detectives of the Bubbling Well Police Station arrived on the scene a few minutes later, no trace of the men could be found. The caretaker was sped away in an ambulance to the Country Hospital, but succumbed before any assistance could be given him.

**Served In Navy**

Mr. Carine, an old China hand, is survived by his Chinese wife and a daughter. Born on the Isle of Man, he served in the British Navy during the first World War, later came to China and was connected with the Chinese Customs in Kowloon. He had been employed as caretaker here for less than a year.

Police admitted last night that there were few clues to work on for the apprehension of the killers. The reports of the various eye-witnesses were said to be rather garbled. Motive for the crime is unknown, but it was pointed out that the gunmen must have had the single immediate objective of slaying the caretaker, since the action was so deliberate.

The home of Mr. G. A. Haley, member of the Shanghai Municipal Council and of the board of directors of the I.C.I., is close by, at 15 Crescent Avenue, and observers recalled the attempted murder of Mr. G. Godfrey Phillips, secretary and commissioner-general of the S.M.C., in January. Mr. Haley refused to comment yesterday on the killing of the caretaker.

**Bombing Attack**

On Saturday morning, terrorists had struck in the bombing attack of the press room of the Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury, in which an Annamite policeman and a pedestrian had been killed by the gangsters. Three workers inside the press room were injured when two hand-grenades exploded, but no appreciable damage to the property was done. Four pedestrians were also wounded by stray bullets in the swift gun-battle between the terrorists and the police.

As a result of the attack, another armored car was stationed beside the Evening Post building, and the number of guards was doubled, while the armored car stationed across from THE CHINA PRESS was turned about so that its gun commanded the entrance to the building.
pages.zh:
《大美晚报》
1946年4月29日

**英国人在“歹土”被谋杀**

**帝国化学工业公司看管员**
**W. B. 卡林**
**遭两名恐怖分子杀害**

昨日上海恐怖活动再次爆发，帝国化学工业有限公司（Imperial Chemical Industrial, Ltd.）大院的英国看管员威廉·布莱思·卡林（William Blythe Carine）先生在“歹土”地区被冷血枪杀。

这名53岁的英国人被两名中国人杀害，他们在卡林先生命令他们离开位于愚园路旁月牙路的大院后，拔出手枪残忍地向他连开数枪。他被救护车紧急送往医院，但在到达之前死亡。

上午9时20分左右，这两名刺客接近帝国化学工业公司的 premises，该处靠近好莱坞赌窟。据警方报告，卡林先生对他们提出质疑，告诉他们这是私人财产，如果穿越就是非法闯入。最后，他命令他们离开。

**故意开枪**

此时，走在前面的恐怖分子冷静而故意地伸手去拿手枪，近距离开枪。随后第二个人也拔出枪，对准看管员，扣动扳机数次。子弹击中目标；卡林先生受致命伤瘫倒在地。

凶手随后毫不费力地逃入“歹土”地区。几名被枪声吸引的旁观者未提供任何援助。

几分钟后，当静安寺捕房的侦探到达现场时，已找不到这两人的踪迹。看管员被救护车火速送往宏恩医院，但在得到任何救助之前就去世了。

**曾在海军服役**

卡林先生是一位中国通，遗下有中国妻子和一个女儿。他出生于马恩岛，在第一次世界大战期间在英国海军服役，后来来到中国，并与九龙的中国海关有关联。他在此处担任看管员的时间不到一年。

警方昨晚承认，在缉拿凶手方面几乎没有线索可循。据说各种目击者的报告相当混乱。犯罪动机不明，但有人指出，鉴于行动如此蓄意，枪手肯定只有一个直接目标，即杀害看管员。

上海公共租界工部局董事兼帝国化学工业公司董事会成员 G. A. Haley 先生的住所就在附近的月牙路15号，观察人士回忆起今年一月上海公共租界工部局秘书兼总办 G. Godfrey Phillips 先生遇刺未遂的事件。Haley 先生昨天拒绝就看管员被杀一事发表评论。

**炸弹袭击**

周六上午，恐怖分子袭击了《上海晚邮报与美华合并报》（Shanghai Evening Post and Mercury）的印刷室，造成一名安南（越南）籍警察和一名行人被匪徒杀害。两枚手榴弹在印刷室内爆炸，三名工人受伤，但财产未遭受重大损失。在恐怖分子与警察之间迅速的枪战中，另有四名行人被流弹击伤。

由于此次袭击，另一辆装甲车被部署在《晚邮报》大楼旁，警卫人数增加了一倍，而部署在《大美晚报》对面的装甲车则调转方向，使其火炮能够控制大楼入口。
